# sample published pool text for make_study tests (mirrors canon/pool-technician.txt layout)
SUBELEMENT T1 - COMMISSION'S RULES [2 Exam Questions - 2 Groups]
T1A Purpose and permissible use of the Amateur Radio Service; Meanings of basic terms
T1A01 (A)
Which agency regulates the amateur service in the United States?
A. The FCC
B. The ITU
C. The Department of Defense
D. The United Nations
~~
T1A02 (A)
What is the purpose of the amateur service?
A. Advancing skills in the technical and communication phases of the radio art
B. Broadcasting music to the general public
C. Providing commercial message traffic
D. Coordinating military communications
~~
T1B Frequency allocations; Emission modes; Spectrum sharing
T1B01 (B)
When must an amateur station transmit its call sign?
A. Every 5 minutes during a contact
B. At least every 10 minutes during and at the end of a contact
C. Once per hour while operating
D. Only at the beginning of a contact
~~
SUBELEMENT T2 - OPERATING PROCEDURES [1 Exam Question - 1 Group]
T2A Station operation: choosing an operating frequency, calling another station
T2A01 (A)
What is a repeater?
A. A station that retransmits your signal on a different frequency
B. A radio that only receives weather broadcasts
C. An antenna with more than one element
D. A type of battery charger
~~
SUBELEMENT T5 - ELECTRICAL PRINCIPLES [1 Exam Question - 1 Group]
T5A Current and voltage: terminology and units
T5A01 (B)
What is the unit of electrical current?
A. Volt
B. Ampere
C. Ohm
D. Watt
~~
SUBELEMENT T6 - ELECTRONIC AND ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS [1 Exam Question - 1 Group]
T6C Circuit diagrams: use of schematics; Schematic symbols of basic components
T6C02 (A)
What is component 1 in figure T-1?
A. Resistor
B. Transistor
C. Battery
D. Connector
~~
